name: HyCraft
tagline: Join a Hytale world from Minecraft Java 1.21.11: walk, build, break, fight and trade items in Hytale's world with an unmodded Minecraft client.

games.label: Hytale (server)
games.runtime: Hytale server API 0.5.2 (built against); a Hytale update can break it

requires.note: a Hytale server you run (with Java 25) or can join; HyCraft goes into its mods/ folder and listens on port 25565
a Microsoft account that owns Minecraft: Java Edition (HyCraft checks it with Mojang, online mode)

notes: How it works: you join a Hytale server with an unmodded Minecraft Java 1.21.11 and play in Hytale's world as a Minecraft player: walk, build, break blocks, fight and use your inventory.

To start: start the Hytale server with HyCraft first (yours or a friend's). Play then starts Minecraft 1.21.11; in Multiplayer pick "HyCraft (Hytale server on this PC)" (localhost:25565) or add your friend's server. A welcome message about a Minecraft client on a Hytale server means it works.
Controls are plain Minecraft. Minecraft players show up in Hytale with a "." before their name.

You need a Hytale server (one you run with Java 25, or a friend's with HyCraft) and a Microsoft account that owns Minecraft: Java Edition (sign-in is checked with Mojang). To host: copy the mods folder from this mod's hytale-server folder (Open folder in the app) into your server folder.

HyCraft listens on port 25565 (change it in the server's mods/HyCraft/main.json). Restore deletes the Minecraft side and the plugin copy; take the jar out of your server's mods/ folder yourself. A Hytale update can break it until HyCraft is updated.
Beta (the author calls it early development, features are incomplete): report bugs to the author with the Report a bug link.
